title: Open climate forecasting challenge

findings.message: rules es version references rules-v4, not current rules-v5.
findings.remediation: Regenerate translated materials from the current rule digest and restart any affected timing windows.

findings.message: rules is missing required ja language coverage.
findings.remediation: Provide the missing translation before opening submissions or mark the language as not required.

findings.message: rules lacks accessible formats for screen-reader.
findings.remediation: Add equivalent accessible formats, then notify affected teams before submissions open.

findings.message: walkthrough is missing required es language coverage.
findings.remediation: Provide the missing translation before opening submissions or mark the language as not required.

findings.message: walkthrough is missing required ja language coverage.
findings.remediation: Provide the missing translation before opening submissions or mark the language as not required.

findings.message: walkthrough lacks accessible formats for captions.
findings.remediation: Add equivalent accessible formats, then notify affected teams before submissions open.

findings.message: walkthrough lacks accessible formats for screen-reader.
findings.remediation: Add equivalent accessible formats, then notify affected teams before submissions open.

findings.message: walkthrough is a required video without captions or transcript.
findings.remediation: Add captions or a transcript before treating the walkthrough as required.

findings.message: submission deadline is not displayed in every solver team's timezone.
findings.remediation: Display UTC plus each eligible team's local timezone before the challenge clock starts.

findings.message: prequalification form is missing es localization.
findings.remediation: Localize prequalification forms before requiring teams to complete them.

findings.remediation: Localize prequalification forms before requiring teams to complete them.

findings.message: prequalification form is not keyboard and screen-reader accessible.
findings.remediation: Add keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels before using the form for eligibility.

releaseCriteria: Required challenge materials cover every solver-team language.
Translations reference the current immutable rule digest.
Required documents, videos, and forms include equivalent accessible formats.
Deadlines are shown in UTC and each eligible team's local timezone.
